name: Dave King
biography: likes to break things. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science Master's degree in Information Assurance. Dave currently does penetration testing, code review, and spews opinions on how to improve security. In past lives Dave has taught at a local college, contributed to a book on PCI compliance, owned his own PCI approved scanning vendor, and was a web developer and system admin for an eCommerce company. After 10 years working mostly on the software side of hacking, Dave now finds himself spending his free time hacking hardware.
